rca_of_issue: RCA: /app/app/admin/layout.tsx had `Wrench` listed twice inside the same destructure block of `import {...} from 'lucide-react'`. Webpack rejects this with SyntaxError 'the name Wrench is defined multiple times' during Vercel production build. Mitigation: removed the duplicate occurrence on line 11; line 7 retains the single canonical import. Verified by (a) `grep Wrench layout.tsx` → exactly 3 hits (1 import + 2 nav usages), and (b) `next build` exit 0 with /admin/proveedores and /admin/mantenimiento both prerendered statically.
